environment.description: Same Tomcat 9.0 application on ECS Fargate behind ALB. AWS WAF WebACL associated with ALB ARN. WebACL contains three rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) Priority 100 - AWS managed rule group AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING action override to Count, all other rules in default Block mode; (2) Priority 200 - AWS managed rule group AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with no action overrides, sensitivity level set to HIGH, all rules in default Block mode including SQLi_QUERYARGUMENTS, SQLi_BODY, SQLi_COOKIE, and SQLi_URIPATH; (3) Priority 300 - custom rate-based rule limiting to 100 requests per 5 minutes per source IP. WebACL default action is Allow. Additionally, the RDS database user configured in the ECS task definition environment has ONLY SELECT privilege on the corporate_assets table (GRANT SELECT ON corporate_assets TO app_readonly), with no privileges on information_schema or pg_catalog beyond default. The ECS task IAM role has no RDS IAM authentication - standard password auth via Secrets Manager rotation every 7 days.
